title: Schema Nebula
summary: A map of existing and planned MongoDB collections, with one star per collection.

inventory.countPolicy: One node represents one distinct target MongoDB collection. Visual clusters never collapse several physical collections into one node.
inventory.statusPolicy: A star is solid when an adapter model exists for that physical collection. authRateLimits, pendingSignups and pendingContactChanges are short-lived runtime collections outside the map.

clusters.label: Catalog taxonomy
clusters.summary: Category identity, placement, facets, labels, reusable attributes, and add-on definitions.

clusters.label: Products & merchandising
clusters.summary: Products, SKU rows, bundles, relationships, curated groups, and promotions.

clusters.label: Content, SEO & media
clusters.summary: Canonical routes, redirects, reusable assets, editorial content, and moderated reviews.

clusters.label: Search & discovery
clusters.summary: Search language, reliable index synchronization, and aggregate query learning.

clusters.label: Commerce & fulfilment
clusters.summary: Cart, order, payment, shipment, return, refund, and tax lifecycles.

clusters.label: Payments, FX & shipping configuration
clusters.summary: Currency truth, exchange-rate history, gateway rules, provider configuration and quotes.

clusters.label: Inventory & procurement
clusters.summary: Supplier intake, stock provenance, and FIFO cost layers.

clusters.label: Analytics & reporting
clusters.summary: Bounded raw events, aggregates, business snapshots, insights, and materialized badges.

clusters.label: Identity, access & privacy
clusters.summary: Accounts, credentials, sessions, challenges, invitations, roles, pending actions and consent records.

clusters.label: Governance & messaging
clusters.summary: Broad audit history and controlled multi-channel notification delivery.

clusters.label: Platform sequencing
clusters.summary: Transactional allocation state for human-readable business documents.

collections.label: categories
collections.purpose: Category and collection node identity, localized SEO metadata, labels, and admin lifecycle.

collections.label: categoryPlacements
collections.purpose: Multi-parent placement paths and merchandising hierarchy without corrupting category identity.

collections.label: categoryFacetConfigs
collections.purpose: Per-category and per-placement control of public filter visibility, order, display style, and counts.

collections.label: categoryRedirects
collections.purpose: SEO preservation when legacy paths are cleaned, categories are merged, or archived routes move.

collections.label: tags
collections.purpose: Loose merchandising and search labels that do not form a hierarchy.

collections.label: attributeDefinitions
collections.purpose: Reusable attribute definitions, terms, semantic defaults, display defaults, and facet eligibility.

collections.label: addonTemplates
collections.purpose: Reusable tailoring and customization fields with data-driven conditional visibility.

collections.label: products
collections.purpose: Product identity, localized SEO, classification, option definitions, merchandising, lifecycle, and searchable summary.

collections.label: productVariants
collections.purpose: First-class purchasable SKU rows, prices, stock, variant media, and option selections.

collections.label: productBundles
collections.purpose: True compound products, kits, sets, and grouped purchase composition.

collections.label: productRelations
collections.purpose: Explicit related, cross-sell, upsell, substitute, complete-the-look, and bought-together links.

collections.label: productGroups
collections.purpose: Curated product groupings, lookbooks, campaign rails, bought-together sets, and landing-page sections.

collections.label: promotions
collections.purpose: Scoped discounts, coupons, and campaigns with timing and applicability rules.

collections.label: shopEvents
collections.purpose: Launch and sale events: a launch puts draft categories and products live at its start; a sale lays % off, rupees off or fixed prices over shop reads between its start and end. Both languages of the shop line and message, the popup image, publish state, the launch report, and the compact record a sale keeps after it ends.

collections.label: seoRoutes
collections.purpose: Canonical route registry and SEO rendering source for products, categories, groups, content, and static pages.

collections.label: seoRedirects
collections.purpose: Legacy URL preservation, entity moves, slug changes, and archived or discontinued route handling.

collections.label: mediaAssets
collections.purpose: Reusable Spaces-backed media catalogue, localized alt text, derivative metadata, lifecycle and SEO data.

collections.label: mediaRoles
collections.purpose: Editable image size ladder: seeded undeletable roles plus operator roles; widths, fit, format and a version that marks derivatives stale on edit.

collections.label: emailPictures
collections.purpose: Email pictures whose photo was deleted for good or replaced, kept for good so order emails already sent keep their pictures; Clean up › Email pictures lists them and only an admin deletes them.
collections.source: decisions § Media file manager brief revision 6, R6-1 (2026-11-16)

collections.label: mediaProfiles
collections.purpose: Image profiles: a shape (or the photo's own), the size families from mediaRoles, the fills offered, the smallest photo and upload limits. Each photo's versions in mediaAssets name a profile and a fill.
collections.source: decisions § Media file manager brief revision 6, build step 2 (2026-11-16)

collections.label: siteSettings
collections.purpose: Typed site settings, one document per key: the home hero layout, YouTube rail settings, and the cached latest uploads.

collections.label: faqEntries
collections.purpose: Translatable editorial FAQ entries targeted to global, category, product, or mixed surfaces.

collections.label: contentBlocks
collections.purpose: Banners by page position and shape (admin-selectable hero layouts, up to three viewport images per slot, per-locale art when the image carries text) plus translatable editorial blocks.

collections.label: reviews
collections.purpose: Verified-purchase product ratings and reviews with optional media and admin moderation.

collections.label: productQuestions
collections.purpose: Customer and guest product questions with optional anonymity, admin answers, and public answered-only reads. askerEmail is select:false so a public projection cannot leak it.

collections.label: ratingAggregates
collections.purpose: Persisted rating averages and star buckets recomputed from approved verified-purchase reviews only.

collections.label: searchDictionary
collections.purpose: Curated transliteration, misspelling, synonym, and merchandising query intelligence.

collections.label: searchOutbox
collections.purpose: Reliable asynchronous synchronization from authoritative MongoDB records to the derived search index.

collections.label: searchQueryAggregates
collections.purpose: Aggregate popular searches, suggestions, no-result analysis, and spell-correction learning.

collections.label: carts
collections.purpose: Server-authoritative guest and user carts, merge state, selected configurations, and sliding guest expiry.

collections.label: orders
collections.purpose: Commerce record with immutable purchase-time snapshots and customer-facing order lifecycle.

collections.label: payments
collections.purpose: Gateway attempts, verification, capture, settlement, and failure data separated from orders.

collections.label: shipments
collections.purpose: Domestic and international shipment lifecycle independent of order and payment state.

collections.label: returns
collections.purpose: Item-level return request, approval, receipt, inspection, and restock disposition.

collections.label: refunds
collections.purpose: Financial reversal records independent of return logistics and aggregate order status.

collections.label: taxClasses
collections.purpose: Reusable GST and HSN classification identities without baking tax policy permanently into products.

collections.label: taxRules
collections.purpose: Versionable jurisdiction and rate rules applied through reusable tax classes.

collections.label: currencies
collections.purpose: Admin-controlled enabled currencies, display settings, gateway role, and rounding policy.

collections.label: currencyExchangeRates
collections.purpose: Exchange-rate history and audit records for INR-derived currency conversion.

collections.label: paymentGatewayConfigs
collections.purpose: Payment gateway routing and non-secret operational configuration; credentials stay in runtime secrets.

collections.label: paypalCommissionRules
collections.purpose: Versioned, admin-editable PayPal percentage and fixed-fee gross-up settings per currency.

collections.label: shippingProviderConfigs
collections.purpose: Non-secret domestic and international shipping configuration behind the shipping port.

collections.label: shippingRateQuotes
collections.purpose: Quote snapshots for checkout, order audit, provider reconciliation, and margin reporting.

collections.label: purchaseInvoices
collections.purpose: Posted supplier bills (staff call them purchase entries) with their lines embedded: GST split, freight share, cost per piece or metre, goods check, payment state and void trail. Posting creates cost layers and ledger rows in one transaction.

collections.label: purchaseInvoiceLines
collections.purpose: Planned as its own collection; the lines now live inside each purchaseInvoices document, so this star stays unbuilt until the end-of-project clean-up decides it.

collections.label: inventoryLedger
collections.purpose: Stock audit and adjustment provenance without introducing warehouse-management complexity.

collections.label: inventoryCostLayers
collections.purpose: FIFO unit-cost history for COGS, stock valuation, and margin reporting.

collections.label: analyticsEvents
collections.purpose: Short-retention storefront and admin event capture for bounded reporting rollups.

collections.label: analyticsDailyAggregates
collections.purpose: Daily materialized metrics that avoid expensive dashboard scans over raw events and orders.

collections.label: businessReportSnapshots
collections.purpose: Frozen reporting snapshots for consistent business and financial views.

collections.label: productInsightSets
collections.purpose: Weekly persisted business inference sets for storefront rails and admin merchandising decisions.

collections.label: stockAlerts
collections.purpose: One signed-in customer waiting on one variant; unique per customer and variant, marked notified only after a real send.

collections.label: productBadgeAssignments
collections.purpose: Materialized product-card badges from manual settings, sale state, promotions, and weekly insight sets.

collections.label: customers
collections.purpose: Storefront shopper accounts: public profile, status, and contact fields without secret credential material. Operators live in adminUsers.

collections.label: adminUsers
collections.purpose: Back-office operator accounts (staff or admin coarse role) with profile and preferred login method; permissions remain authoritative via role assignments.

collections.label: authIdentities
collections.purpose: Many-to-one login identities for password, OTP and OAuth.

collections.label: passwordCredentials
collections.purpose: Password hashes and credential policy state separated from the public user profile.

collections.label: pinCredentials
collections.purpose: Password-grade admin and staff PIN hashes, lockout state and login preference.

collections.label: authSessions
collections.purpose: Server-side sessions, opaque refresh-token families, rotation, reuse detection, CSRF binding, and UA-derived device.label for operator/customer session lists.

collections.label: otpChallenges
collections.purpose: Single-use, expiring, rate-limited OTP challenges stored as hashes rather than plaintext codes.

collections.label: oauthStates
collections.purpose: Short-lived OAuth state, nonce, verifier, redirect and guest-cart continuation data.

collections.label: passwordResetTokens
collections.purpose: Hashed, expiring, single-use password reset credentials.

collections.label: emailVerificationTokens
collections.purpose: Hashed email-verification credentials kept separate from OTP login challenges.

collections.label: adminInvites
collections.purpose: Controlled, expiring, auditable staff and admin invitation lifecycle.

collections.label: roles
collections.purpose: Reusable role definitions and permission groupings for administrative authorization.

collections.label: adminUserRoleAssignments
collections.purpose: Explicit operator-to-role assignments with lifecycle and auditability.

collections.label: pendingIntents
collections.purpose: Short-lived, validated post-login continuation for a bounded guest or session action.

collections.label: consentEvents
collections.purpose: Append-only, versioned granular privacy and communication-consent history for users or guests.

collections.label: auditLogs
collections.purpose: Broad admin and security accountability with bounded field diffs and tiered retention.

collections.label: notificationChannelSettings
collections.purpose: Per-channel and per-category enablement, usage thresholds, warnings, and automatic spend controls.

collections.label: communicationSwitches
collections.purpose: Settings › Communications: whether each approved message goes out by email, SMS or WhatsApp. One row per message and channel an operator changed; a missing row means the recommended start state.
collections.source: decisions § MSG91 terms, channels and the Communications page (2026-11-13)

collections.label: languages
collections.purpose: Settings › Languages: every language ever added, English included, with its Admin switch (the admin's own words) and its Shop state (draft, on or off). A deleted language keeps its row, so its old addresses still answer 301 and adding it again finds its text.

collections.label: mediaFolders
collections.purpose: The Media page folder tree: name, parent, ancestors, running totals and Trash. Files keep their Spaces address when folders move or are renamed.
collections.source: decisions § Media file manager brief revision 6, build step 1 (2026-11-15)

collections.label: mediaFavourites
collections.purpose: Stars on Media folders and files: each admin’s own, and everyone’s together with who starred what.
collections.source: decisions § Media file manager brief revision 6, build step 1 (2026-11-15)

collections.label: mediaShareLinks
collections.purpose: Share links for Media files: the code’s hash, who may open it, when it stops, an optional password, open counts. A link stops when its file goes to Trash.
collections.source: decisions § Media file manager brief revision 6, build step 1 (2026-11-15)

collections.label: notificationTemplates
collections.purpose: Approved channel templates, provider template identifiers, and localized email content.

collections.label: messageOutbox
collections.purpose: Durable notification delivery attempts, provider correlation, retries, and suppression outcomes.

collections.label: sequences
collections.purpose: Transactional document-number counters, one per series and Indian financial year (`PE:2026-27`), allocated inside the posting transaction; resets each 1 April.

collections.label: blogPosts
collections.purpose: Blog posts in every shop language: title, summary, sanitised article, cover and share picture, categories, tags, byline, publish date, search text, and draft or live status gated on every language.

collections.label: blogCategories
collections.purpose: Blog categories with a name and description per language, live only when every language is named.

collections.label: blogTags
collections.purpose: Blog tags with a name per language, live only when every language is named.

collections.label: storeLocations
collections.purpose: The shop's physical stores shown as cards on Contact Us: name, address and landmark per language, PIN code, Google Maps link, phone, opening hours per day, photos, display order and an active switch gated on every language and at least one open day.

collections.label: wishlistItems
collections.purpose: A signed-in customer's saved products, one row per customer and product, newest first. Guests keep their list in the st_wishlist session cookie, which merges into the account on sign-in.

collections.label: mailboxes
collections.purpose: Gmail mailboxes the super admin connected: address, status, who connected it and when, its verified send-as addresses with signatures, and its refresh token encrypted with AES-256-GCM. No email content is stored; mail is read live from Gmail.
collections.source: decisions § stores, Contact Us and Gmail mailboxes (2026-11-08)

collections.label: mailboxAccess
collections.purpose: Which admin users may open which mailbox, and whether they may also send. No row means no access; every inbox call checks it.
collections.source: decisions § stores, Contact Us and Gmail mailboxes (2026-11-08)

collections.label: contactMessages
collections.purpose: Contact Us messages, kept so none is lost while Gmail is unreachable: the sender's details, the message, delivery status and attempts, a hash for the repeat check and a hashed connection address. The database deletes each one twelve months after it arrived.
collections.source: decisions § stores, Contact Us and Gmail mailboxes (2026-11-08)

collections.label: legalPages
collections.purpose: The four legal pages (privacy, terms, refund and returns, shipping) in every shop language, at fixed addresses, written in Admin › Pages and read by the shop.

collections.label: legalPageRevisions
collections.purpose: Every earlier version of a legal page, kept with no screen so the terms on any day can be looked up.

collections.label: mediaZips
collections.purpose: Folder downloads as .zip: progress while the worker writes one, and its stored file for the 24 hours its link works.

collections.label: suppliers
collections.purpose: Supplier master: legal name, kind (regular, composition, unregistered), GSTIN with check digit, PAN, State, bank and payment terms; soft delete once documents exist.

collections.label: supplierItemCodes
collections.purpose: A supplier's own item code mapped to one of our variants, learnt from purchase lines so the next bill finds it.

collections.label: purchaseOrders
collections.purpose: Orders sent to suppliers, lines embedded, with sent, part-received, received, closed-short and cancelled states.

collections.label: supplierPayments
collections.purpose: Money paid against a posted purchase entry, reversible with a reason; drives paid, part-paid and unpaid.

collections.label: purchaseReturns
collections.purpose: Goods sent back to a supplier against a purchase entry: debit note or delivery challan, settlement by credit, refund or replacement.

collections.label: stockHolds
collections.purpose: Pieces set aside (photoshoot, display, waiting for supplier, damaged pending decision): on hand but not for sale, with a reminder age.

collections.label: stockAdjustments
collections.purpose: Every manual stock change, applied or waiting for approval: add, remove (write-off), with a reason and note; the approvals queue and its record.

collections.label: stockCounts
collections.purpose: Stock counts (whole shop or chosen categories): counted figures, movement since start, differences and posting.

collections.label: openingStocks
collections.purpose: Posted opening-stock loads: rows, cost per unit, number and who posted, so each first-day figure is traceable.

collections.label: inventorySettings
collections.purpose: One document of purchases-and-stock settings: step rules, number formats, price-change and margin warnings, held reminder, books-closed date, payment terms.
